description: This file implements the SecurityAgent class for a security plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes initialization, token creation, token validation, and request processing functionalities, manages security contexts, configuration, and communication with external components.

classes.name: SecurityCallsign
classes.description: Implements the ISubSystem::ISecurity interface, providing security callsign information.

classes.name: SecurityAgent
classes.description: Main class implementing the security agent functionalities such as token handling, security context management, and request processing.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the security agent, loads configuration and ACL, sets up token dispatcher and security subsystem.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters monitor, and resets internal state.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Information
methods.description: Returns informational string about the security agent; currently empty.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a security token based on input buffer.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Officer
methods.description: Validates a token and returns a corresponding security context.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests related to token creation and validation.
